thread.title: Nasdaq loses grip on 7,000 for first time in 3 weeks as stock-market selling accelerates - MarketWatch

author: Mark DeCambre
title: Nasdaq loses grip on 7,000 for first time in 3 weeks as stock-market selling accelerates - MarketWatch
text: The Nasdaq Composite Index on Thursday lost its purchase above the round-number level above 7,000 for the first time since early April, as selling pressure in the stock market gathered steam late morning. The Nasdaq [c: COMP] was down 1.4% at 6,998, most recently. The technology-laden gauge last closed below 7,000 on April 9. Losses in the highflying sector come even as earnings reports from the likes of Amazon.com Inc. AMZN, -1.23% Facebook Inc. FB, -1.64% and Apple Inc. AAPL, -0.95% have come out better than expected. Meanwhile, the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -1.31% most recently, was down about 340 points, or 1.4%, while the S&P 500 index SPX, -1.29% shed 1.4% at 2,599. Both the Dow and the S&P 500 have slipped below their 200-day moving averages, which are used by technical traders to help determine bullish and bearish momentum in an asset.
